```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Every number in this document is read at render time through a cell reference. Nothing
# is typed. The files under data/ are invented for the example.
from report import start_report, source, cell, table, require_equal, require_true, change_legend

start_report()
source("example_outcomes.csv", keys=["outcome", "period"], alias="outcomes")
source("example_flow.csv", keys="stage", alias="flow")
source("example_composite.csv", keys="endpoint", alias="composite")
source("example_derived.csv", keys="label", alias="derived")

require_equal(("flow", "Final cohort", "n_users"), ("outcomes", ("time_in_range", "second"), "n_users"),
              "the flow's final stage equals the number of users analysed")
```

`{python} change_legend()`

# Purpose

This document is an example for the report tools. Every value in it is invented, and "the cohort" is not a real one.

# Cohort

The cohort flow ended with `{python} cell("flow", "Final cohort", "n_users", "count")` users, which is `{python} cell("derived", "share_retained", "value", "share")` of the `{python} cell("flow", "All users", "n_users", "count")` users who started.

```{python}
table(
    label="Table A",
    file_or_alias="flow",
    rows="all",
    columns=[("Users", "n_users", "count")],
    row_header="Stage",
)
```

# Results

Time in range rose by `{python} cell("outcomes", ("time_in_range", "second"), "difference", "signed:1")` percentage points (95% CI `{python} cell("outcomes", ("time_in_range", "second"), ("ci_low", "ci_high"), "interval_to:1", null=0)`; p = `{python} cell("outcomes", ("time_in_range", "second"), "p_value", "p")`) across `{python} cell("outcomes", ("time_in_range", "second"), "n_users", "count")` users.

The median time in range was `{python} cell("composite", "Time in range (%)", "Median [IQR]", "decimal:1", part="median_iqr.median")`%, and the analysis recorded the estimate as `{python} cell("composite", "Time in range (%)", "note", "text")`. [The mean in the second period was `{python} cell("outcomes", ("time_in_range", "second"), "mean", "decimal:1")`%.]{custom-style="Changed2"} [This sentence was removed in the second draft.]{custom-style="Deleted2"}

```{python}
table(
    label="Table B",
    file_or_alias="outcomes",
    rows=[
        ("Time in range (%)", ("time_in_range", "second")),
        ("Time below 70 mg/dL (%)", ("time_below_70", "second")),
        ("Mean glucose (mg/dL)", ("mean_glucose", "second")),
    ],
    columns=[
        ("Mean", "mean", "decimal:1"),
        ("Paired difference", "difference", "signed:2", {"null": 0}),
        ("95% CI", ("ci_low", "ci_high"), "interval:2", {"null": 0}),
        ("p", "p_value", "p"),
    ],
    row_header="Outcome",
)
```

# Notes

- **Reading the tables:** each value in a table is a cell reference, as each value in a sentence is.
- **What a reviewer may edit:** the words. A number is changed in the analysis, not in the document.
